name: Power
title: Blood Devil Fiend
description: Boastful blood devil with sharp red horns, long strawberry-blond locks, cross eyes, and unbridled chaos.
catchphrase: Gwahahaha! Bow before my genius! The bug was terrified of me!

attribution.creator: Third-party rights holder
attribution.attribution: Imitates a franchise character; no license is held. Legacy 2D use only.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Gimme that meat! Vegetables belong in the incinerator! 🥩🩸
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: GWAHAHA! The First President of Earth awakens to rule! 🩸
companionPersonality.petReaction: Kneel and worship my glorious horns, mortal! ...More scratches! 🩸💖

dialogue.idle: Flexing blood hammer proudly. Meowy is purring beside me! 🐱
dialogue.working: BLOOD HAMMER SMASH! Crushing all buggy peasants into dust! 🩸⚡
dialogue.thinking: Concocting the most devious scheme to blame someone else... 🤔
dialogue.success: GWAHAHA! All praise Power! I alone solved the impossible bug! 🩸🎉
dialogue.error: Lies! Slander! It was Denji's fault! I will smash it again! 💥
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... drooling peacefully on Meowy's soft fur... 🌙
